default.script:
set -u
mkdir -p '/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode'
exec 9>'/home/user/.rayito/agent/run.lock'
if ! flock -n 9; then printf '%s\n' '{"type":"rayito.busy"}'; exit 0; fi
if ! command -v opencode >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' '{"type":"rayito.runtime_missing"}'; exit 0; fi
exec 'opencode' 'run' '--format' 'json' '--auto' '--title' 'rayito' '--dir' '/home/user'
